description: Navigation-only mapping of the 36 L3 roots onto the 36 unordered pairs of I Ching trigrams (8 self-pairs + 28 distinct pairs). Not part of any root's definition; concepts/concepts.jsonl remains canonical.

bridges.note: Undivided energy — the creative doubled, met as both ground and lens.
Heaven and earth together: the whole. Responsibility is total because 'you are the world'.
Creative force meeting movement and change — mutation, not gradual reform.
Unbounded possibility working through the subtle, persistent instrument of thought.
Possibility met through insecurity and depth — freedom *from*, not freedom to choose.
Energy and illumination: seeing the false as false, immediately.
The creative met through ending and stillness — dying each day to the known.
Unbounded energy as communion; love approached by negation, never as desire.
Receptive attention doubled — choiceless observation, without the effort of concentration.
Receptivity meeting change: learning as a living movement, not accumulation.
Attention turned on the conditioning that shapes it — the mirror of relationship.
Receptive attention held to human depth: sorrow neither escaped nor explained away.
What is, met through illumination — a pathless land, not a conclusion.
Earth and mountain: the trees, the light, the living world as a doorway out of the self.
Attention and communion — beauty where the 'me' is momentarily absent.
Movement doubled: action that is the immediate expression of perception.
Movement driven by conditioning — becoming, achieving, postponement.
Disturbance meeting insecurity: the friction of what is against what should be.
Movement clinging to an image — including the image of non-violence.
Change met through stillness; order as the outcome of understanding disorder.
Movement and sensation: thought's demand that a sensation continue.
Conditioning doubled — the shaping so pervasive it is mistaken for oneself.
Subtle influence meeting insecurity: the craving for psychological security.
Thought's persistent pressure clinging to an image of what should be — will as hardened desire.
Conditioning met as fixed ground: the guru, the system, one's own accumulated experience.
Conditioning entering relationship as measurement — 'all comparison is violence'.
The abysmal doubled: thought projecting remembered pain into the future.
Depth and image: thought's fragmenting action, me and not-me.
Insecurity met as stillness — the ache of isolation, and aloneness that is not it.
Insecurity seeking communion, and inventing it: faith, ideology, dogma.
Illumination doubled — consciousness *is* its content, the whole field of thought.
The image met as ground: the thinker is the thought, the observer the observed.
The image falling silent so communion is possible — 'listening is a great miracle'.
Stillness doubled: not a method or a practice, but the emptying of the known.
Stillness meeting communion — the mind that may come upon the sacred.
Communion doubled; relationship as the mirror in which the self is revealed.
